I’ve seen too many setups like this. Fear stopped you from buying yesterday, and greed made you chase higher today. What the market is best at is getting you to make the “emotionally correct” decision at the wrong time.

There’s only one rule of discipline: don’t chase with positions that weren’t established before the breakout.

━━━ Strategy Direction ━━━
Holders: $75,000 is the key support. If it holds, continue holding; if it breaks, reduce exposure and wait.

SEC and CFTC classify XRP and SOL as commodities: this time, it’s not a negative—it’s regulatory easing

The two major U.S. regulators have moved XRP and SOL into the commodities category, bypassing SEC securities regulation—an upside catalyst directly.

Against the backdrop of the crypto policy shift, the SEC and CFTC have classified XRP and SOL as commodities. Don’t underestimate this classification—securities and commodities follow completely different regulatory paths in the U.S. Securities have to go through the SEC’s issuance and disclosure framework; commodities fall under the CFTC, where constraints are much looser. XRP has been tangled in an SEC lawsuit for four years because of the question of whether it counts as a security. Now that the classification is finalized, it effectively stamps these coins with a legal identity, and future legislation and regulatory frameworks will be adjusted around this categorization.

The market is already reacting: XRP is up 16.23% in 24 hours to $1.419, the strongest among major coins; SOL is up 5.23% to $91.1. BTC $91.1,316.01 (+7.88%), and ETH $2,388.05 (+4.95%) are also strengthening.

Market impact
- Short term: Regulatory certainty is one of the hardest catalysts, especially for XRP, which has been under litigation pressure for years. This is basically “bad news fully priced in” plus an identity turn to approved—capital is clearly flowing back. Risk appetite across the broader market is also boosted; BTC holding above $91.1K suggests this isn’t just altcoin hype.
- Medium term: Classifying them as commodities means subsequent legislation will likely revolve around the CFTC framework. More tokens may be handled along this path. Listing standards on exchanges and institutional compliance channels are likely to loosen, and the industry landscape should move in a more positive direction.

My take
Strongly bullish. Regulatory classification is a trend-level positive, not a one-day trade. After BTC stabilizes at $91.1,316.01, the area around $91.1K is near-term support—only if it breaks would I turn more cautious. After XRP jumps 16%, don’t chase in the short term; a pullback to confirm would make the trend healthier. The key risk is policy reversal—if the classification document faces legal challenges, sentiment could drop quickly, so this needs close monitoring.

SEC和CFTC在加密政策转向的背景下，把XRP和SOL定性为大宗商品。别小看这个定性，证券和大宗商品在美国的监管路径完全不同：证券要走SEC的发行、披露那一套，大宗商品归CFTC管，约束宽松得多。XRP之前被SEC诉讼缠了四年，就是卡在“是不是证券”这个问题上。现在定性落地，等于给这些币的法律身份盖了章，未来立法和监管框架都会围绕这个分类重新调整。

盘面已经在给反应了：XRP 24小时涨16.23%报$1.419，是主流币里最猛的；SOL涨5.23%报$91.1。BTC $91.1,316.01（+7.88%）、ETH $2,388.05（+4.95%）跟着走强。

- 中期：定性为商品意味着后续立法会围绕CFTC框架展开，更多代币可能参照这个路径处理。交易所上币门槛、机构合规通道都会跟着松，行业格局往好的方向走。

Now that both major regulators have softened their stance, it effectively grants these two blockchain networks a “non-security” passport.

In other words, it has the entire chain—from issuance and custody to quotation on regulated trading—put together end to end.

But no matter how good the card looks, if you dig deeper, it still makes you uneasy—because this setup relies extremely heavily on a “single core node.”

To put it plainly, DuskTrade can move more than €300 million in securities onto the chain, and its confidence all comes from NPEX’s qualifications and its committed funds. In other words, NPEX is the absolute centerpiece of the whole big plan. Imagine what happens if, one day, NPEX’s internal operations run into trouble—or if it can’t withstand local regulatory pressure and announces it’s no longer playing. Dusk doesn’t have a second licensed institution of the same caliber it can conjure up on the fly to rescue the situation. This kind of deep, exclusive binding is exactly the Achilles’ heel that could choke it at any moment.

What’s even more frustrating is that the pace of business rollout isn’t fully controlled by the public chain itself. Even HTX admits that “timing risk” objectively exists. Although the EU has MiFID II, MiCA, and DLT pilots to backstop the market, the global financial industry’s attitude toward tokenization is still completely split between ice and fire. In its November 2025 report, IOSCO clearly sounded the alarm and pointed directly to new regulatory risks embedded in this space. Domestically, the CSRC has recently taken decisive action via window guidance, effectively blocking the RWA path that securities firms were pursuing in Hong Kong.

This brings us to a painful reality: no matter how brilliant the underlying code is, it’s useless without real funds and assets to run on. Dusk’s current situation is that the technical logic works, but the business closed loop is extremely dependent on the traditional finance establishment’s facial expressions. As soon as macro policy tightens, or a key ally drops out, the entire infrastructure could grind to a halt. In this line of work, lacking a “Plan B” for self-defense really isn’t acceptable—and this is exactly where I’m truly worried about the trajectory after $DUSK . #eth $ETH

title: Неочікуваний зліт $BTC
subTitle:
Змова чи спланована кампанія сім’ї Трампа, щоб заробити ще більше на криптовалюті?
19 серпня 2026 року на крипторинку стався масовий шорт-сквіз. Саме по $BTC за одну годину було примусово ліквідовано понад $1 млрд коротких позицій, а за 24 години обсяг ліквідованих BTC-шортів сягнув близько $1,7 млрд. Загалом по крипторинку за добу було знищено близько $3 млрд ведмежих ставок.
Це стало можливим тому, що останні місяці ринок був ведмежим і трейдери масово стояли в шортах. Достатньо було сильного руху BTC вгору і почався ланцюг примусових ліквідацій, які, у свою чергу, ще сильніше підштовхнули ціну.
Чому так сталося?
Спочатку Мінфін США збільшив обсяг викупу довгострокових облігацій. Ринок сприйняв це як сигнал можливого збільшення ліквідності.
А потім Трамп зібрав у Білому домі керівників Coinbase, Kraken, Robinhood та інших криптокомпаній разом із представниками SEC і CFTC та закликав Конгрес схвалити Clarity Act — закон, який має створити чіткі правила для крипторинку США.
І ринок вибухнув 💥
BTC піднявся майже до $70 000, $ETH показав ще сильніший рух, а крипторинок загалом пішов угору.
Чого очікувати далі?
15 вересня 2026 року Сенат має повернутися до розгляду Clarity Act. Це може стати одним із ключових моментів для крипторинку США.
А для сім’ї Трампа крипторинок — це вже великий бізнес. За даними Reuters, криптопроєкти принесли родині понад $1,4 млрд. Trump Media також накопичує біткоїни, а World Liberty Financial активно розвиває власну криптофінансову екосистему.
Тому питання виникає саме по собі: чи може політична підтримка крипторинку одночасно бути вигідною сім’ї Трампа?
Це ще не доказ змови. Але збіг інтересів дуже цікавий.
Що далі?
Ходять чутки, що продавці закінчилися і розворот уже відбувся.
Інші дивляться на чотирирічний цикл $BTC . Якщо історія повториться, справжнє дно може бути ще попереду — орієнтовно в районі жовтня.
Хто правий — не знає ніхто.
Можливо, ми вже побачили кінець ведмежого ринку.
А можливо, це просто дуже красивий short squeeze перед наступним падінням.
Тож рекомендую пристебнутися. Наступні пів року точно не будуть нудними. 🚀#BTC #ETH

With BTC’s rebound, Strategy’s Bitcoin holdings are now showing a floating profit of $1.4 billion, and the corporate coin-hoarding narrative is back in favor.

Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy)’s Bitcoin holdings have turned into a substantial floating gain following this round of BTC’s rebound, with book profit of about $1.4 billion. The company is the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin holder. Its core strategy is to use debt financing to buy BTC. When BTC fell from its previous highs, the book value was under pressure for a time, and the market even questioned whether this model would be sustainable. Now BTC is back at $77,053.99, up 6.37% over the past 24 hours. The holdings have returned to a comfortable zone—essentially a stress test validating the path of “allocating BTC to the corporate treasury.”

Impact on the market
- Short term: Positive for sentiment. Floating from loss to profit is the most straightforward narrative catalyst, strengthening institutions’ confidence in BTC as a reserve asset, and capital may continue to flow in. XRP is up more than 10% in 24 hours, indicating that overall risk appetite is recovering and it’s not a BTC-only show.
- Medium term: Strategy’s floating profit will become a template case. When other listed company CFOs read their financial statements, “swap part of the treasury cash for BTC” becomes a more convincing option. Corporate allocation demand is a slow variable, but the direction is accumulating.

Bullish, but don’t chase. After BTC moves above $77,053.99, in the short term watch whether the 75K area can hold. If it holds, that provides the foundation for the rebound to continue. In a bear-market recovery, the most dangerous thing isn’t the drop—it’s that you can’t help yourself.

BTC $77,076 (+6.52%), ETH $2,418 (+4.52%). Prices are going up, but don’t forget—this is called a BEAR_RECOVERY, not a bull market. ETH’s structure looks worse: CHOP_MID means the direction hasn’t been established, and going long or short both drain your capital and patience.

━━━ Seen this too many times ━━━
The rebound comes, and the people who can’t hold cut losses and leave; then after another push higher, the ones who missed the move start chasing; and then the market hits you with a big red candle, and the people who just entered end up being the ones to take the other side. This isn’t a story—it’s the real loop most people go through.

━━━ How to look at things right now ━━━
BTC is repairing from the bottom of the bear market, with a slightly bullish bias, but the structure is still not clean. ETH hasn’t formed a trend—it's just grinding in a range. In this kind of market, keep your position size light and your patience heavy; your win rate is worth more than your diligence.

The right trade today happens at the moment you’re waiting, not at the moment you chase in.

US Treasury Debt Breaks $4 Trillion: This BTC Rally Pushes to 77K as the Logic Quietly Shifts

The US debt has surpassed $4 trillion, which is a long-term positive for the BTC narrative. But in the short term, price still depends on liquidity and the mood of the US dollar.

The total US Treasury debt has officially crossed the $4 trillion mark, a historic milestone. The pace of debt expansion is still accelerating, and interest payments are taking up an increasing share of the budget. Analysts are very direct: every time this number climbs another rung, BTC’s long-term rationale as a “decentralized hard asset” gets that much stronger. At the same time, they also caution that the real driver of BTC’s short-term price is still US Treasury yields, the US Dollar Index, and global liquidity—while the debt story is a slow variable. Currently, BTC is trading at $77,398.01, up 6.20% over the past 24 hours. ETH is $2,423.83, up 3.30%.

Market impact
- Short term: Don’t expect debt-news headlines to directly lift the market. In the short run, price is anchored to the Federal Reserve’s path and the strength of the dollar. The debt data itself doesn’t create buy-side demand. Today’s 6% rally is more a market sentiment repair than an escalation of the debt narrative.
- Medium term: This is one of BTC’s most solid long-term stories. The stronger the expectation that fiscal deficits will be monetized, the greater the institutional incentive to allocate to BTC as a hedge. This is also where the underlying logic of ETF capital flows comes from.

My take
I’m bullish, but I see it in two time horizons. In the short term, BTC is around $77,398.01. Resistance is first seen at the 80K round-number level; support is around 73K. If BTC can hold above 80K, it will open up new upside space. The real significance of debt breaking $4 trillion is that it adds another narrative foundation for long-term holders—the dilution of fiat is certain, and BTC’s scarcity is also certain. The risk is: if Treasury yields spike due to concerns about debt, liquidity tightens, and in the short term that may suppress the coin price. Bullish narrative and liquidity headwinds could exist at the same time.

Strategy账面浮盈14亿美元：BTC反弹回成本线，机构示范效应来了

💡 Positive catalysts: BTC’s rebound is back above Strategy’s cost basis, and the company-level logic of accumulating coins is running again.

Strategy’s Bitcoin holdings have returned above the cost basis line, with an unrealized gain of $1.4 billion; the “institutional coin accumulation” narrative is revived.

What happened
This rebound pushed BTC to $77,398.01, up 6.20% in 24 hours. The price has once again climbed above Strategy’s overall cost basis line for its total BTC holdings (the original MicroStrategy). The company’s on-paper unrealized profit has returned to $1.4 billion. In plain terms: the “U.S. publicly traded company’s largest Bitcoin long,” which has been sitting at an unrealized loss on the books for the past few months, finally shows unrealized gains again.

One-sentence translation: The books of institutions using BTC as a reserve asset have been recalculated—and it works out again.

Market impact
- Short term: A direct positive boost in sentiment. Strategy’s unrealized profit implies that potential refinancing/buy-coin channels may reopen. In the past, whenever Strategy’s share price rose in tandem with BTC, the company would issue debt and/or equity to add to its position, creating a “rally → financing → buying → further rally” loop. BTC in the near term may challenge the $78K–$80K range; a pullback to $75K is the first support.
- Medium term: A demonstration effect for other listed companies. During earnings season, the idea that “holding BTC = unrealized gains on the books” will encourage more firms to allocate idle cash to BTC. With institutions adopting the same rhythm, the pace accelerates—one of the hardest narratives in this cycle.

My view
Clearly bullish. The $1.4 billion unrealized profit isn’t the key point—the key is the cost basis line being recovered after being lost. That sets an example for all corporate finance officers who have been watching from the sidelines. The risk is also very clear: if BTC falls back below $75K, the unrealized profit turns into an unrealized loss, and the narrative flips again. On positioning, just watch those two levels: $75K support and $80K resistance.

subTitle:
#ETH $ETH

$ETH Ethereum is back in the spotlight after U.S. spot Ethereum ETF pulled more than $220 million in fresh capital on August 20. The funds recorded more $219 million in net inflows, extending their winning streak to four consecutive trading days. BlackRock’s ETHA once again dominated the session with about $173 million in inflows.
That puts the August 20 flow above the $189.15 million recorded one day earlier. The back to back inflows suggest institutional demand has not slowed after Ethereum’s sharp recovery.
ETH is also surging above the $2,300 level.  Ethereum trading around the $2,360 area in recent market data, with its market cap remaining above $270 billion.
BlackRock’s ETHA accounted for roughly $173 million of the August 20 inflows. That was followed by BlackRock’s ETHB with about $35.9 million, while Fidelity’s FETH added $5.8 million.
Bitwise’s ETHW brought in around $2.8 million. VanEck’s ETHV added another $1.7 million. The remaining products recorded either smaller flows or no meaningful change during the session.
The result is important because it came immediately after the $189 million inflow recorded on August 19. That earlier session had already been described as Ethereum’s strongest single day since October 2025.
As of now, August is shaping up as a major turnaround for Ethereum ETF. The funds had struggled through May and June, when combined net outflows exceeded $1 billion.
The money is moving in the opposite direction. Ethereum ETFs have posted several consecutive positive sessions while ETH has reclaimed levels that looked out of reach during the recent weakness.
Ethereum price action is giving the ETF numbers even more weight as it jumped sharply during the recent move, reaching above $2,300 and briefly trading near $2,400.
The token’s recovery also came with a sharp improvement in sentiment. Ethereum is now testing whether the $2,300 area can turn into support rather than another temporary stop. That matters because ETF demand is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore. Four straight days of inflows means institutions are adding exposure while ETH is already trading significantly above its recent lows.
There is another supply signal worth watching. Santiment data previously showed exchange held ETH falling from roughly 7.70 million coins on June 2 to 6.54 million on August 18. That represents a decline of around 15% over 11 weeks.
$ETH sitting on exchanges can reduce immediately available selling supply. Combined with stronger ETF demand, that creates an interesting setup if buying pressure continues.
The big question now is whether Ethereum can turn this ETF momentum into a sustained breakout as the $2,400 area is the next obvious test. If ETH clears it decisively while ETF inflows remain strong, the market could start looking toward the next major resistance levels.
For now, the message from Wall Street is getting louder: institutions are buying the dip, and Ethereum is listening.

I need to use this money next week. Even with the highest APY, I wouldn’t just save it carelessly.
Today I looked at TermMax’s lending market, and I almost made the same old mistake again: I immediately went to the column with the highest APY.
Then I thought better of it. Suppose I have 5,000 USDT, with 3,000 being idle funds, and the other 2,000 might need to be used as additional margin next week—these two sums basically can’t go into the same basket. For that latter 2,000, even if the page’s returns look great, I wouldn’t put it into a position that matures after the date I need the money.
#ETH  
TermMax’s fixed-rate lending isn’t hard to reason about: once you deposit the debt asset, you receive FT; then at maturity, you redeem it according to the rules. The yield and dates are easier to calculate at entry. But “easy to calculate” doesn’t mean “easy to get back anytime.” If you want to exit before maturity, you usually have to see whether there are buyers for FT at the time, and what the price looks like. When the market is thin, selling early at a discount may eat up the interest.
So now I don’t just ask, “What’s the annualized rate?” I first ask three questions:
When is the earliest I need to use the money?
Which day does the market position mature?
If I exit on short notice, is the depth of FT sufficient?
Here’s a very rough example. Put 5,000 USDT into a 30-day deal with an annualized return of 10%. If everything goes perfectly, you’d only make around forty-something U. If you need the money temporarily and have to endure an extra 1% discount to exit, then 50U would be gone. It looks like good returns, but once you do the math, you actually end up losing.
Of course, both the 10% and the 1% are just convenient assumptions to illustrate the point, not the current quotes.
This is also the biggest change in my view of TermMax recently. In the past, I thought the focus of fixed-rate lending was “the interest stays the same.” Now I feel it’s forcing you to confront the maturity: when the money comes back matters far more than whether the page shows a couple percent more or less.
If I really plan to use it, I’ll split the funds according to the dates I’ll need them. Keep a short-term reserve in hand, and for the portion that you know you won’t need for a while, match it with an appropriate maturity date. Don’t force yourself into a situation where you *have* to sell FT at a discount just to chase a few dozen U in expected gains.#termmax  @termmax

content:
这笔钱下周要用，再高的 APY 我也不敢随便存
今天看 TermMax 的出借市场，我差点又犯老毛病：先找 APY 最高的那一栏。
后来想想不对。假如手里有 5,000 USDT，其中 3,000 是闲钱，另外 2,000 下周可能要补保证金，那这两笔钱根本不能放在同一个篮子里。后面那 2,000，就算页面收益再好看，我也不会拿去做一个到期日晚于用钱日期的仓位。#ETH  
TermMax 的固定利率出借，逻辑不难：存入债务资产后拿到 FT，等到期按规则赎回。收益和日期在进场时更容易算清楚。可“算得清楚”不等于“随时都能拿回来”。没到期就想退出，通常要看 FT 当时有没有买家、价格怎么样，市场薄的时候，提前卖出的折价可能把利息吃掉。
所以我现在不会只问“年化多少”，而是先问三句：这笔钱最早什么时候要用？市场哪天到期？如果临时退出，FT 的深度够不够？
举个很粗的例子。5,000 USDT 做30天，年化按10%算，满打满算也就四十来U。要是为了临时用钱，退出时多承受1%的折价，50U就没了。看起来不错的收益，账一算反而倒贴。当然，10%和1%都只是方便说明的假设，不是当前报价。
这也是我最近看 TermMax 最大的改观。以前觉得固定利率的重点是“利息不变”，现在更觉得它是在逼人正视期限：钱什么时候回来，比页面上多两个点、少两个点重要得多。
真要用的话，我会把资金按用钱日期拆开。短期备用金留在手里，确定一段时间不用的部分，再去匹配合适的到期日。别为了几十U的预期收益，把自己逼成必须低价卖FT的人。#termmax  @termmax

8.22, $BTC , early morning analysis
We’re not going to look at moving averages or MACD. Let’s take a different “anti-human nature + deconstruct-the-play” angle to look at this dataset.
First, look at that sell order worth $75.94 million.
To retail traders, it looks like “a wall of selling pressure.” To the big players, it’s “bait.” If a real whale wanted to quietly unload, they would split the order into smaller lots and post them across different price levels. They would never hang an “obvious declaration” of nearly a hundred million in the order book to scare you. This order is placed at 79,555—only $445 away from the 80,000 round-number level. The purpose is overwhelmingly likely to be a “door sign” used to create panic—intentionally placing it there to push retail traders to cut long positions or even open shorts ahead of the 80,000 mark. Then they can take these short tickets in one bite and, in the momentum, drive the price up and break through 80,000. Next, look at the $1.111 billion net inflow.
But don’t get too excited yet. Think: who is buying? If it were all institutions accumulating aggressively, the price wouldn’t hover around 77,280 for so long—it would have been driven up in a straight line much earlier. Of that $1.111 billion, perhaps 70% is fueled by retail traders who chased in after seeing the big move—FOMO (fear of missing out). The main force is using retail traders’ money to prop up that “trap” at 79,555.

短期看多。停战信号 + 全市场普涨，情绪面和资金面共振。BTC 站稳 $77,330.59 之上，下一目标看 $80,000 整数关口；回踩 $75,000 不破就是强支撑。ETH 在 $2,400 附近，弹性略弱于大盘。风险点：伊朗国内强硬派反弹、谈判破裂，避险情绪重来会直接砸盘。仓位思路留一半清醒，地缘行情来得快去得也快。

Iran Calls for Ceasefire and Says It “Won” — Why Didn’t BTC Drop This Time, and Instead Rose?

💡 Impact on the Call: Bullish 📈 — Expectations of easing geopolitical tensions + a cooling in risk-off sentiment, raising the risk-asset inflow risk.

One sentence to make it clear: When the Iranian president publicly calls to end the war, the geopolitical risk premium starts to unwind, and BTC held up against sell pressure at $77,330.59.

What happened

The Iranian president directly said this fight with the United States and Israel should end, and he also claimed Tehran is the winner. In plain terms, it’s finding a way to save face—speech can’t lose, but the body wants a ceasefire. For the market, this signal matters far more than the back-and-forth rhetoric itself: the chain of “conflict escalation → oil price spikes → inflation rebounds → rate-cut expectations rise” now has a chance to be broken.

The transmission path is straightforward: ceasefire expectations → oil prices fall → inflation pressure eases → Fed rate-cut room opens up → easier liquidity is bullish for BTC. BTC rose 6.80% over 24 hours to $77,330.59, ETH gained 3.21% to $2,401.84, and XRP even surged 9.66%—the market is already voting with real money.

One-sentence translation: The expectation that the war will stop is essentially loosening conditions for global risk assets—crypto has the highest elasticity.

Market impact

- Short term: Risk-off sentiment fades. Funds that previously hid in gold and the US dollar may flow back into risk assets like BTC. BTC volume and price surged 6.80% in 24 hours, suggesting that sell pressure has largely been digested.
- Medium term: If the ceasefire is actually confirmed—oil stabilizes, inflation cools, the probability of a September Fed rate cut increases—then easier liquidity is the biggest medium-term narrative for the crypto market. Conversely, if it’s just Iran’s one-sided bluster and Israel doesn’t engage, the conflict could keep flaring; then some of the gains would likely be given back.

My take

I’m bullish on the direction, but not blindly bullish. Calling for ceasefire is only the first step; the landing still depends on follow-up negotiations. After BTC holds $77,330.59, the next test is whether it can defend the $75K prior high-density trading zone; if there’s a reversal in the Middle East (e.g., Israel’s retaliatory action), a pullback is likely. ETH follows BTC—whether it can stabilize around $2,400 is key. My view: the main thesis holds—geopolitical easing + rate-cut expectations—but the rhythm will likely see repeats; chasing highs is worse than waiting for a pullback to confirm.

伊朗总统直接放话：这场跟美国和以色列的仗该结束了，还顺带宣称德黑兰是赢家。说白了就是找个台阶下——嘴上不能输，但身体想停战。对市场来说，这信号比打嘴仗本身重要得多：冲突升级→油价飙升→通胀反复→加息预期抬头的这条链子，现在有望被掐断。传导路径很直白：停战预期→油价回落→通胀压力缓解→美联储降息空间打开→流动性宽松利好BTC。BTC 24小时涨6.80%到$77,330.59，ETH涨3.21%到$2,401.84，XRP更是拉了9.66%，市场已经在用真金白银投票了。

一句话翻译：战争要停的预期，等于给全球风险资产松绑，加密是弹性最大的那个。

对市场的影响

- 短期：避险情绪退潮，之前因为战事躲进黄金和美元的资金，会重新流向BTC这类风险资产。24小时BTC放量涨6.80%，说明抛压已经被消化得差不多了。

我的判断

方向看多，但不是无脑多。停战喊话只是第一步，落地还得看后续谈判。BTC站稳$77,330.59之后，下一个考验是能不能守住$75K这个前期密集成交区；如果中东出现反复（比如以色列报复行动），回踩就是大概率。ETH跟着BTC走，$2,400附近能不能企稳是关键。我的观点：地缘缓和+降息预期这条主线成立，趋势向上，但节奏上会有反复，追高不如等回踩确认。

【Retail investors think “after a 27% rise it’s time to run,” but the data slaps back】

Many people see ETH up 27% this week and the first reaction is, “That’s about enough,” “Time to get out.” I’m all too familiar with this—back in 2017 I got cut because of it. I ran after a small move up, and then it doubled again.

But this time I’m not hesitating because of the price—I’m hesitating because of the underlying fund flows.

In the past 48 hours, ETF inflows have exceeded $800 million. Of that, ETH funds saw a daily inflow of $220 million, the highest since October. Institutions are buying—that’s a fact, not something I’m making up. Even more important: within two days, nearly $3.8 billion worth of short positions were closed, breaking the record since 2021.

Do you know what that means?

When leveraged shorts get swept, it means the shorting force in the near term has been cleaned out. But it also means—potential long momentum has already been partially consumed ahead of time. Institutions are buying spot ETFs, while what’s getting swept is high-leverage shorts. Put together, the effect is: price is pushed up, but the real selling pressure hasn’t arrived yet.

Right now, ETH is stuck around 2400, with resistance at 2492. This level is interesting—up by another 4% puts it into a strong pressure zone. If it breaks out, longs will likely ride the move. But if it can’t hold here, a pullback to 2260 becomes possible.

Someone asked me why institutions are buying ETH at this time. One story is that ETH has retraced 51% from its high. For those old retail “veterans” from 2017, that number carries a psychological cue: “Back then, I bought the dip right around here.” But whether that logic can actually play out depends on whether the ETF product design and institutional compliance processes can truly absorb the capital.

I’m currently leaning cautious. Not because I’m bearish, but because chasing in at this level doesn’t offer a good risk-reward. Opportunities are in two places: either wait for a breakout above 2492, then look for confirmation on the pullback; or wait for 2260 to hold, followed by a second rally.

Of course, these are just my thoughts—if I get it wrong, it’s not on me.

What state are you in right now? Is your position heavy? When this run-up happened, did you get itchy or not?

【散户以为“涨了27%就该跑了”，但数据打脸了】

很多人看到ETH这周涨了27%，第一反应是“差不多了吧”“该跑了”。这种想法我太熟了，2017年我被割就是栽在这个上面——涨了一点就跑，结果跑完又翻倍。

但这次让我犹豫的不是价格，是背后的资金流向。

过去48小时，ETF流入了超过8亿美元，其中ETH基金单日流入2.2亿，是10月以来最高的。机构在买，这是事实，不是我的意淫。更关键的是，两天内将近38亿美元的空头被平仓——这个数字破了2021年以来的记录。

你懂这意味着什么吗？

杠杆空头被扫了，意味着短期做空的力量被清洗了一遍。但这也意味着——潜在的多头力量已经被提前消耗了一部分。机构买的是现货ETF，而被扫的是高杠杆空头，两者叠加的效果就是：价格被推上去，但真正的抛压还没来。

现在ETH卡在2400，阻力在2492。这个位置有意思——往上4%就是强压力区间，如果突破，多头会顺势；但如果这个位置横不住，回撤到2260的可能性就存在。

有人问我为什么机构这个时候买ETH？有一种说法是，ETH从高点回撤了51%，对于2017年那波老韭菜来说，这个数字有心理暗示——“当年我在这个位置抄底过”。但这个逻辑能不能落地，要看ETF的产品设计和机构合规流程能不能真正把资金接住。

我现在偏谨慎。不是看空，是觉得这个位置追进去，盈亏比不划算。机会在两个地方：要么等突破2492之后回调确认，要么等2260守住后的二次拉升。

当然，这只是我的判断，说错了我也不负责。

你们现在什么状态？仓位重不重？这波涨上来手痒没痒过？

After BTC breaks above $79,000, concept stocks such as Canaan, Strive, Metaplanet, and others have posted double-digit gains. The stock market has turned into a leveraged amplifier for BTC’s rise.

In essence, part of the traditional capital that doesn’t dare buy coins directly is borrowing the stock route to ride this trend.

Impact on the market
- Short term: Concept stocks are rising more than BTC itself, which reinforces the market’s bullish sentiment. I’m clearly bullish on this move. A breakout of $79,000 on rising volume is the key signal. After it holds, the next target is around $85,000. How to Confirm an Ethereum Breakout 🧠📊

{future}(ETHUSDT)

When $ETH  breaks a resistance level, many traders immediately enter.

But a breakout is not automatically a confirmed trend change.

Here are 4 things to check:

🔹 1. Daily Close
Did ETH actually close above resistance, or was it only an intraday spike?

🔹 2. Volume
A breakout supported by increasing spot volume is generally more convincing than a move on weak volume.

🔹 3. Retest
The strongest setup can come when old resistance becomes new support.

🔹 4. Market Structure
Look for higher highs and higher lows on higher timeframes.

📌 Simple framework:

Breakout → Volume confirmation → Retest → Continuation

Don't buy simply because the candle is green.

Confirmation > FOMO.

title: Your Biggest Risk May Be the Story You Tell Yourself.
subTitle:
Every investment begins with a story. "This project will grow." Adoption will increase." "This technology will change the industry." "Price will eventually reflect its potential." A story can give you conviction.
But a story can also become a trap. Once we become emotionally attached to an investment, we may start interpreting every piece of information in a way that supports our belief.
Good news becomes confirmation. Bad news becomes "temporary." Warning signs become "FUD." And suddenly, we're no longer evaluating the investment. We're defending it.
🔑 Key Takeaway: A thesis should guide your investment not imprison you. Your job isn't to make your original prediction come true. Your job is to continually ask whether the evidence still supports it.
🧠 Practical Reflection; Ask yourself: If I didn't already own this asset, would today's information make me want to buy it?" That question can expose emotional attachment surprisingly quickly.
Thought for the Day. Conviction is knowing why you believe. Wisdom is knowing what could change your mind.
Systems over emotion. Conviction over noise.
